delta_sign: comparator FPR minus ProvGuard FPR; positive favors ProvGuard
aggregate_unit: training seed and shared evaluation row; crossed resampling preserves pairing and row dependence across seeds
multiple_testing: Holm correction across all available per-seed exact McNemar tests (30 at completion); CIs are pointwise 95%, not simultaneous
scope: Predefined comparisons and usable/external HB subsets; stress-set inference is conditional on public sample coverage.
